name: Aconite Embroche
original_name: アコナイト・アンブロシ
source: Aconite was the very first vampire leader and the main progenitor of the Embroche vampire family tribe and he was also the first to wield the legendary Deese Morte greatsword. Once an extremely powerful vampire, he is long thought to be dead but there are some indications that he still might be alive in some form through the blood of his descendants.
